notes.title: Power Up - Active Type => ex : Glide Bomb
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26943504/025ac30d3fe54a31416c2d981cb203930cbfcbeb.png[/img]

Last few weeks we added a big part to our game DragoDino => Power Up System. A rogue like need to have lots of type power up randomly generated :).

The system :
- three slots available,
- three types => Consumable, Passive and Active,
- each power up upgrades one DragoDino's skill or something else,
=> The player is free to choose his own combination to enhance his play style :) !

As final example we show you how to become a Bomber. That is an "Active Type" adding skill to your DragoDino !

https://www.facebook.com/DragoDinoGame/posts/763005887197340?aymt_tip=1&placement=aymt_boost_post_with_ads_intent_notification&notif_t=aymt_boost_post_with_ads_intent&notif_id=1485015154973812
